name: junco-agency
description: Recursive Pi agencies: dataflow graphs of Agentic members driven by one schedule-only Pi scheduler.

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/workflows/index.ts --root ./src --outdir ./dist --target node --format esm --packages external --splitting --sourcemap=external && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.build:examples: bun build ./examples/recursive-agency.ts ./examples/mixed.ts ./examples/oss-committee.ts ./examples/mcp.ts ./examples/yak-shaver.ts --root ./examples --outdir ./examples/dist --target bun --format esm --packages bundle --splitting --sourcemap=external --env=disable --external junco-tools/native --external @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent --external @earendil-works/pi-agent-core --external @earendil-works/pi-ai --external @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent --external opik
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:integration && bun run test:native
scripts.postinstall: if [ -x "${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share/junco-tools/cargo}/bin/cargo" ]; then cd packages/junco-tools && bun run build:native; else echo 'postinstall: no Rust toolchain for junco-tools (see packages/junco-tools/README.md); skipped its native addon' >&2; fi
